headline: H100 SXM and H200 lead weekly gains while MI300X holds best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index rose +16% over 7 days to $5.00, and H200 climbed +11% to $6.00, the sharpest moves in the tracked set.
B200 was nearly flat at +1% with a $8.55 market index, while MI300X, A100 80GB SXM and L40S were unchanged at +0%.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +147%, with a hyperscaler median of $10.68 against a neocloud median of $4.32.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, though only 5 providers list it, and RunPod Community Cloud's median is $0.50.
A100 80GB SXM is the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour, despite a low $2.70 market index.
watch: Watch whether the +16% weekly run-up in H100 SXM, and the +11% rise in H200, continues or spreads to B200, which has moved only +1%.
